scientific_limitations: The exact statement is full-line, real, uniform-grid, harmonic-mean interior-slope cubic Hermite interpolation. It does not assert the same bound for finite-endpoint PCHIP rules, nonuniform spacing or other slope limiters. Near-plateau data approach the sharp value, which need not be attained by a finite pair.
source_date_integrity: The lead paper was printed in a June 1984 issue with no day given; the publisher verifies 2006-07-14 as the exact online-publication day. That online day is used as exact publicly verifiable date evidence, not recharacterized as the original printed publication day.
title: Sharp two-input bounded-variation stability of harmonic-mean cubic Hermite interpolation
